prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: modular construction tilesheet for AlgoLand's watermill, inspired by the supplied reference IMAGE ONLY FOR STYLE AND MATERIALS. Generate separate reusable building components, NOT a complete assembled house and NOT the reference chopped into rectangles.
STYLE: high-resolution hand-painted 2D fantasy RPG illustration, smooth crisp contours, warm orange terracotta, honey-brown timber, ivory plaster, gray stone, soft upper-left daylight. Absolutely NO pixel art, no pixelated edges, no voxel render. Preserve the reference's painted material quality.
CAMERA: elevated orthogonal 3/4 RPG view with consistent roof pitch, front wall planes and visible roof top surfaces. No different cameras between pieces.
LAYOUT: one square transparent-background atlas with precisely 6 columns and 6 rows of equal-sized cells, each component centered in its cell with clear transparent gutters. Intended graphic grid 256px per cell on a 1536px square canvas, components based on 64px logical module (4x graphical density). No labels, no text, no grid lines, no background, no assembled miniature buildings. Repeating surfaces fill their useful square; silhouettes have transparent cutouts. Consistent scale across components, door 2 wall modules high when assembled.
ROW 1 six roof components: left sloped roof edge; repeatable center field of terracotta shingles; right sloped roof edge; ridge middle; ridge left endcap; ridge right endcap.
ROW 2: front triangular timber gable left half; matching gable right half; horizontal eave middle; left eave corner; right eave corner; stone chimney.
ROW 3: plain repeatable plaster wall panel without framing; wall panel with vertical central timber; left wall outer corner timber; right wall outer corner timber; horizontal timber beam segment; diagonal brace independent.
ROW 4: stone foundation straight section; left foundation corner; right foundation corner; separate closed arched wooden door with stone frame; separate shuttered window with amber glass; wooden entrance step module.
ROW 5: stone channel left bank straight; channel right bank straight; channel bank elbow left; bank elbow right; wooden elevated sluice trough middle DRY EMPTY; wooden sluice gate frame DRY EMPTY.
ROW 6: ONE isolated complete wooden waterwheel without water and without stone bank; independent axle with metal bearing; independent wooden supporting post; barrel; wooden crate; flower box.
IMPORTANT functional layering: no painted water on channel stone pieces, no water painted on wheel, no terrain or foliage painted into repeatable plaster/roof tiles, no baked house-wide shadows, no roof glued to walls, no windows glued to whole facades. Individual motifs should read as genuine modular kit pieces for building multiple mill shapes. Wheel has center axle pivot; base props bottom-center pivots; collision design will use only building footprints and channel banks. Single neutral spring base sheet for visual development; seasonal derivation and engine assembly are subsequent steps. No water animation frames requested on this architectural sheet. Every cell contains exactly one intended component with no overlap into neighbors.
